FrostStoneIngots_5001.description: A highly enriched ingot of pure Froststone, it maintains an unyielding cold even in the fiercest heat.

FrostStoneOres_5001.name: Froststone Ore
FrostStoneOres_5001.description: A chunk of raw material that pulses with the eternal cold of the frozen abyss.

FrostStonePowder_5001.name: Froststone Powder
FrostStonePowder_5001.description: Powder made by finely grinding Froststone ore.

FrostWyvernClaws.name: Frost Wyvern's Claws
FrostWyvernClaws.description: These razor-sharp talons, forged from glacial ice, are as formidable as the beasts that wield them.

FrostWyvernEgg.name: Frost Wyvern Egg
FrostWyvernEgg.description: Mystical egg, cool to the touch, encapsulating the delicate balance of fragility and resilience.

FrostWyvernsHide.name: Frost Wyvern's Hide
FrostWyvernsHide.description: A dense, frost-encrusted layer torn from the icy beast's form. It gleams with the frozen essence of the abyss, a testament to the Wyvern's mastery over the icy expanse.

FrostbittenMallet.name: Frostbitten Mallet
FrostbittenMallet.description: A hammer forged from the essence of cold gathered from the monsters of Frost Mountain. It is the only weapon capable of shattering the sealed wyvern statue, which no ordinary weapon can break. Once the statue is destroyed, the Frost Wyvern will awaken.

FrostedFeather.name: Frosted Feather
FrostedFeather.description: This feather, taken from the Ice Harpy’s wings and covered in an eternal layer of frost, embodies the icy spirit of its frigid realm.

FrostlightAbyssPlateArmor_5001.name: Frostlight Abyss Plate Armor
FrostlightAbyssPlateArmor_5001.description: A striking set of plate armor forged from a rare ore that pulses with eternal frost, providing both a stalwart defense and an intimidating presence.

FrostlightAketon_5001.name: Frostlight Aketon
FrostlightAketon_5001.description: A quilted armor pulsing with the cold of the frozen abyss, offering flexible protection that adapts to the wearer's movements.

FrostlightCloak_5001.name: Frostlight Cloak
FrostlightCloak_5001.description: Crafted from fabrics touched by the eternal chill, this cloak offers a serene yet powerful presence, echoing the quiet strength of ancient ice.

FrostlightCrusaderHelm_5001.name: Frostlight Crusader Helm
FrostlightCrusaderHelm_5001.description: An imposing crusader helm crafted from Froststone Ingots, intertwining the chilling touch of the frozen abyss with the enduring might of the noble and the devout.

FrostlightCrystalSword_5001.name: Frostlight Crystal Sword
FrostlightCrystalSword_5001.description: Skillfully crafted and imbued with the enduring cold of Froststone, this crystal sword seamlessly integrates magic, transforming into an adept vessel for arcane power.

FrostlightFeatheredHat_5001.name: Frostlight Feathered Hat
FrostlightFeatheredHat_5001.description: A charming hat infused with Froststone Powder, merging the perpetual frost of the frozen abyss with the quick-witted finesse of the nimble and clever.

FrostlightGauntlets_5001.name: Frostlight Gauntlets
FrostlightGauntlets_5001.description: Forged from mystical Froststone, these gauntlets meld the biting chill of eternal ice with a rugged, battle-ready construction.

FrostlightHood_5001.name: Frostlight Hood
FrostlightHood_5001.description: A sleek hood crafted from Froststone Powder, intertwining the frigid touch of the frozen abyss with dark allure.

FrostlightLanternShield_5001.name: Frostlight Lantern Shield
FrostlightLanternShield_5001.description: This shield emanates an everlasting cold that remains steadfast even in the most intense environments. Its retractable blade and lantern offer invaluable support for combat and exploration.

FrostlightLeatherLeggings_5001.name: Frostlight Leather Leggings
FrostlightLeatherLeggings_5001.description: Crafted from reinforced leather and suffused with timeless cold, these leggings offer agile movement with the glacial strength of the abyss.

FrostlightLightfootBoots_5001.name: Frostlight Lightfoot Boots
FrostlightLightfootBoots_5001.description: Light and durable, these leather boots are imbued with the arcane resilience of froststone, ensuring swift movement through diverse challenges.

FrostlightMysticGloves_5001.name: Frostlight Mystic Gloves
FrostlightMysticGloves_5001.description: Exquisitely crafted and intricately designed, these gloves draw from the frozen abyss, allowing spellcasters to wield their magic with finesse.

FrostlightNormanNasalHelm_5001.name: Frostlight Norman Nasal Helm
FrostlightNormanNasalHelm_5001.description: A fierce helm wrought from Froststone Ingots, merging the glacial force of the frozen abyss with the primal fury of its bearer.

FrostlightOracleRobe_5001.name: Frostlight Oracle Robe
FrostlightOracleRobe_5001.description: A flowing robe imbued with the frost of ancient realms, enhancing the wearer’s mystical presence with an ethereal chill.

FrostlightPlateBoots_5001.name: Frostlight Plate Boots
FrostlightPlateBoots_5001.description: Provides formidable protection, powered by the icy essence of the frozen abyss, though their clunkiness might slow you down a bit.

FrostlightPlatePants_5001.name: Frostlight Plate Pants
FrostlightPlatePants_5001.description: Sturdy plate pants forged from froststone ore, integrating the icy resilience of the frozen abyss into every plate and rivet.

FrostlightRivetedGloves_5001.name: Frostlight Riveted Gloves
FrostlightRivetedGloves_5001.description: Riveted with enchanted froststone, these gloves offer a seamless blend of the abyss's icy power and rugged durability.

FrostlightRuggedBoots_5001.name: Frostlight Rugged Boots
FrostlightRuggedBoots_5001.description: Combining thick leather and compact fur lining, these boots are infused with froststone’s chilling essence, offering both warmth and formidable durability.

FrostlightRunestoneGloves_5001.name: Frostlight Runestone Gloves
FrostlightRunestoneGloves_5001.description: These leather gloves, inlaid with froststone facets, offer a perfect blend of flexibility and the frigid power of mystical frozen ice.

FrostlightSpear_5001.name: Frostlight Spear
FrostlightSpear_5001.description: This spear combines the piercing power of a traditional spear with the icy might of the frozen abyss, making each attack chillingly effective.

FrostlightTrousers_5001.name: Frostlight Trousers
FrostlightTrousers_5001.description: Woven from light, enchanted fabric, these trousers are permeated with infinite freeze, offering both dexterity and the relentless chill of the glacial depths.

FrostlightWarMaul_5001.name: Frostlight War Maul
FrostlightWarMaul_5001.description: A War Maul forged from refined Froststone. The frozen head is strong enough to shatter any metal, and its icy chill seeps into the wielder’s hands. Thick gloves are essential to wield it.

FrostlightWardenOutfit_5001.name: Frostlight Warden Outfit
FrostlightWardenOutfit_5001.description: An ensemble that blends the resilience of the frozen abyss with the natural agility of the wilderness, offering a balance of strength and flexibility.

FrostlightWizardHat_5001.name: Frostlight Wizard Hat
FrostlightWizardHat_5001.description: An exquisite creation fashioned from Froststone Powder, combining the chilling power of the frozen abyss with arcane elegance.

FrozenClaw.name: Frozen Claw
FrozenClaw.description: A claw that fell from an Ice Hound. Though its tip is slightly chipped from the aftermath of a fierce struggle, a lingering chill still clings to it.

FrozenHeart.name: Frozen Heart
FrozenHeart.description: From the lifeless blue heart of the already deceased Wendigo, emanates a chilling aura of ruthless death, pulsating with a faint heartbeat.

FrozenIronKey.name: Frozen Iron Key
FrozenIronKey.description: A weathered iron key encased in frost, hinting at locked mysteries buried in the coldest reaches.

TidalFalchion_5001.name: Tidal Falchion
TidalFalchion_5001.description: A falchion forged from sharply honed Tidestone. Its weight remains substantial, yet it moves more smoothly underwater. The broad teal blade shimmers with an iridescent glow whenever it catches the light.

TidalJesterCap_5001.name: Tidal Jester Cap
TidalJesterCap_5001.description: A whimsical jester’s cap. The Tidestone beads at the tips of its horns shimmer with a gentle light even beneath the water.
